Support to justice sector reform development including increased access to justice in Eastern Congo (North+South Kivu and Ituri). Co-financing arrangement (Transfer Agreement) between the EU Commission (Lead donor 10 mill euro), Sweden (60 000 000 SEK) and Belgium (2 mill euro), within the framework of the 10th European Development Fund (10th EDF).
